decisions.reason: As a specialist naval system it likely required meaningful engineering and certification investment and fits the firm's demanding-environment portfolio, so management would be reluctant to reverse course after only a year.

Its own webpage shows visible commitment, but a spring-balanced desk lamp is somewhat less central to the firm's stated push toward intelligent application-wide lighting, so it carries a moderate but not dominant withdrawal risk.

This is a core interior-lighting product with its own page and an explicit new-launch presentation, closely matching the firm's mainstream business and strategic direction, so early removal is unlikely.

A pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics fits the company's established interior and office lighting offer, and even with limited website emphasis management would usually keep such a new core-range product on the market longer.

Although it fits the firm's specialist marine business, the HMI technology is less aligned with the stated move toward more sustainable LED-based solutions and the public commitment appears limited, so it has the highest removal risk of the group.

A marine searchlight matches the firm's robust specialist-lighting capabilities, and despite only modest visible commitment the firm would typically continue backing such a niche product rather than quickly admitting a failed launch.
